name: Edison Opto Corporation
summary: Edison Opto Corporation is a company dedicated to the development, production, and global distribution of light-emitting diode (LED) lighting solutions. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide range of offerings, from core LED components, AC/DC modules, and LED strips, to specialized applications. These include external illumination for streets and outdoor areas, advanced lighting systems for horticulture and stage productions, and vehicle lighting solutions. The company also innovates with UV modules and infrared emitters. In addition to physical products, Edison Opto provides comprehensive integrated services, encompassing both lighting design and manufacturing. Established in 2001, the company maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan, serving a worldwide clientele.
